title: Congruence of gate unfolding
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $g$ be a well-formed gate, and let $t,t'$ assign a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables to each gate argument and polarity. If $t(a,q)=t'(a,q)$ for every argument $a$ of $g$ and every polarity $q$, then unfolding $g$ using either assignment gives the same circuit at every polarity $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is well formed: its argument list has no repetitions and, if it is a NOT gate, has length one
$t$ and $t'$ agree at every argument of $g$ and every polarity
